claims.text: Gabapentin: respiratory depression may occur with CNS depressants, including opioids, or with underlying respiratory impairment; monitor and adjust the dose as appropriate.
claims.quote: Respiratory Depression: May occur with NEURONTIN when used with concomitant central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including opioids, or in the setting of underlying respiratory impairment. Monitor patients and adjust dosage as appropriate
